answer: The dawn counter is kept in lagoon and ledge exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2314 identities would post 4487 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
